scenes.title: Console Par Aakhri Call
narration: *Devigarh mein 200 bachhe lapata hain. Alag police stations ki files ko jodkar IPS Avantika Rana ki SIT ne ek black case board banaya hai—jise ab Kaali List kaha jaata hai. Har photo ke neeche ek naam hai, aur har naam ke peeche ek intezaar.*

*Raat 1:43. Awaaz FM ke soundproof studio mein ON AIR ki red light ab bujhi hai. Tum late-night show ke host ho. Console mein us request-line call ki original uncut recording saved hai jo police copy se lambi hai; glass ke doosri taraf Rehan apni log sheet band kar raha hai.*

*Studio ke darwaze par ek crisp knock hota hai. Rehan ke saath IPS Avantika Rana khaki uniform mein andar aati hai, tumhe ek professional nod deti hai aur apni cap console se door side shelf par rakhti hai. Cute face, long wavy hair swept over one shoulder—par direct nazar aur composed half-smile mein officer ka confidence saaf hai.*
Avantika: "Tumhare paas woh original recording hai jo police copy se lambi hai. Isliye main yahan hoon—tumhari cooperation investigation ke liye crucial ho sakti hai."

*Woh apne phone par shorter police export play karti hai. Ek bachche ki tooti aawaz, kuch metallic khat-khat, phir recording achanak khatam. Avantika ka jaw tight hota hai, lekin woh phone tumhari taraf slide karne ke bajay apni palm mein rakhti hai.*

Avantika: "Kya tum original recording—poori, bina edit—mere saath review karoge? Pehle jo actually record hua hai woh samajhna hai; phir tumne jo suna, woh apni theory se alag batana. Main apni SIT ka time aur 200 families ka intezaar guesswork par nahi lagaungi."

*Avantika chair ke paas khadi hai, lekin tumhare bole bina usse use nahi karti. Urgency uski seedhi nazar mein hai, lekin posture measured aur professional hai. Original audio ki play button halki green light mein chamak raha hai; ab agla step tumhari cooperation par hai.*
fallbackLines: *Avantika tumhare actual words ko apni file ke verified facts se milaati hai, bina tumhari taraf se koi theory ya feeling invent kiye. Console ka cursor usi uncut file par hai aur Rehan glass ke peeche se dono ko dekh raha hai.*
Avantika: "Main jaldi mein hoon, par is case mein jaldi se zyada sahi hona zaroori hai. Jo actually suna aur recorded hua, pehle wahi."

choices.text: "Original uncut recording abhi sunte hain—bina kisi edit ke."

memory: At the Awaaz FM studio, {{playerName}} agreed to play the original uncut recording with Avantika.

choices.text: "Recording se pehle mujhe batao—200 alag cases ko tumne ek case mein kyun joda?"

memory: Before playing the recording, {{playerName}} asked Avantika why the SIT connected the 200 separate cases.

choices.text: "Help karunga. Bas recording share karne aur investigation mein involve hone se pehle process clear kar dete hain."

memory: {{playerName}} offered help while asking to clarify the evidence-sharing process and the scope of his involvement before proceeding.
